inputs.ad_text_01: A five-second black-and-white historical editorial documentary shot. Fine silver-gelatin photographic grain, neutral grayscale, soft natural light, restrained realistic human gestures, physically coherent surroundings. Locked wide shot, gentle natural motion, crisp photographic detail. No text, no subtitles, no letters, no numerals, no logos, no watermark, no split screen, no graphics, no montage, no shot changes. This is an original illustrative reconstruction, not authentic archive footage. An early 1930s construction site in New York. Two construction workers wearing caps and work clothes inspect a large paper blueprint on a timber table, behind them a modest steel building skeleton and a crane. One points to the plan while the other nods. Emphasize workers, paper plans, steel framing, no completed skyscraper.
